fullContent:
Yograj Guggulu 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Amavatarogadhikara 90 – 95, Rasaratnasamucchayam. 
 Introduction 
 Yograj Guggulu is a very eminent Ayurvedic medicine in tablet form helpful to maintain Vata balance. This tablet having Guggulu (Commiphora mukul) as its base. It is extensively used in the Ayurvedic treatment for various types of arthritis. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Chitraka (Plumbago zeylancia) – 10 grams 
 Pippalimoola – Long pepper root – Piper longum – 10 grams 
 Yavani (Trachyspermum ammi) – 10 grams 
 Karavi – Piper chaba – 10 grams 
 Ajamoda (Trachyspermum roxburghianum) – 10 grams 
 Jeeraka – Cumin seed – 10 grams 
 Devadaru (Cedrus deodara) – 10 grams 
 Chavya (Piper cubeba) – 10 grams 
 Ela – Cardamom – 10 grams 
 Saindhava Lavana – Rock salt – 10 grams 
 Kushta (Saussurea lappa) – 10 grams 
 Rasna (Pluchea lanceolata) – 10 grams 
 Gokshura (Tribulus terrestris) – 10 grams 
 Dhanyaka  – Coriander – 10 grams 
 Triphala – Haritaki (Terminalia chebula), Vibhitaki (Terminalia bellirica), Amalaki (Emblica officinalis) – 10 grams 
 Musta – Cyperus rotundus – 10 grams 
 Trikatu – Pepper, Long pepper and Ginger – 10 grams 
 Twak – Cinnamon – 10 grams 
 Usheera (Vetiveria zizanioides) – 10 grams 
 Yavagraja (Hordeum vulgare) – Barley – 10 grams 
 Taleesapatra (Abbies webbiana) – 10 grams 
 Patra (Cinnamomum zeylanicum) – 10 grams 
 Guggulu – Purified (Commiphora mukul) – 270 grams 
 Sarpi – ghee – Sufficient Quantity 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 First 27 herbs till Guggulu (in the above ingredients list) are taken in fine powdered form. Guggulu (gum resin) is taken in an extensive wide mouthed vessel and heated till it gets liquefied. After this rest of the ingredients are added to it and mixed well. Ghee is also added and the whole mass is well pounded. Finally it is rolled and converted.to tablet form of uniform size around 500 mg. 
 Dosage 
 Consume 1-2 tablets 2-3 times a day, before or after having meals or as suggested by Ayurvedic doctor. Have it along with Honey or butter milk. 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 
 Yograj Guggulu is widely used Ayurvedic treatment for Rheumatoid arthritis and Gout. 
 Also useful remedy in case of Worm infestation, infected wounds and to treat bloating. 
 It also deals with problem of Splenomegaly and abdominal tumors 
 It also increases digestion power, complexion, strength and immunity. 
 It is mainly used for diseases affecting bone, joints and bone marrow. 
 
 Contraindications/ Side Effects 
 
 It is better to use this product under medical supervision. 
 Self-medication with this medicine is discouraged. 
 Very high dose than prescribed may lead to stomach irritation. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
